title: Redwood April 2026 All-Hands
summary: Monthly company all-hands focused on Q1 results, product roadmap updates (Hosted, Dedicated, Private), reliability and security progress, hiring plan, and ops metrics. Leadership shared wins, constraints and next steps for OKRs and customer-facing launches. Q&A covered pricing, Dedicated adoption, and compliance timeline.
topics: Product roadmap: Dedicated & Private launch timelines
Customer success stories and churn risk
next_steps: Eliot to share the all-hands slide deck link by 2026-04-03
Product to publish Dedicated rollout schedule and pilot signup form by 2026-04-10
Security to send updated SOC2 artifact checklist to sales and CSMs by 2026-04-07
